{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out sentinel values (biomarker_baseline == -999)
print("Filtering out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999...")
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]
print("Rows after filtering sentinel values:", len(df_filtered))

# Step 2: Deduplicate by keeping highest sample_seq per patient
print("Deduplicating by highest sample_seq per patient...")
df_deduped = df_filtered.loc[df_filtered.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]
print("Rows after deduplication:", len(df_deduped))

# Step 3: Compute mean baseline biomarker
mean_baseline = df_deduped['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Output result
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}")

# Return the mean
mean_baseline"}
